Third-party notices for the Workbench presentation editor
==========================================================

This file accompanies the editor bundle in client/vendor/workbench-slides/editor/
(built from https://github.com/JimLiu/open-artifact, component
@open-artifact/slides-editor 0.14.6, commit
132c038529e4527d1bc30561a855ffd958aa7302; see UPSTREAM.json). The editor
itself is licensed under the Apache License 2.0: see LICENSE and NOTICE beside
this file.

The bundle also contains code and fonts from other projects. Upstream ships no
third-party notice file, so this one was written for TaroBird on 2026-11-27
from what could be identified in the shipped files:

  - JavaScript libraries: found in editor/assets/index-*.js by their own
    strings or code (version strings, error messages, generated class names),
    and matched to the versions pinned in upstream's package-lock.json at the
    commit above.
  - Fonts: the seven editor/assets/inter-*.woff2 files; copyright and version
    read from the name table of each file.
  - WebAssembly: two modules embedded in editor/assets/index-*.js (one of them
    also in editor/assets/worker-*.js), built with wasm-bindgen; crates read
    from the source-location strings inside the modules, versions as recorded
    there and in upstream's Cargo.lock.

Part 1 gives the licence text of each component whose licence file could be
read. Part 2 lists components that are in the bundle but whose licence file
was not available when this file was written; their notices still have to be
added. Part 3 lists what upstream declares as a dependency but was not found
in the bundle. The list is not established to be complete.


PART 1. COMPONENTS IN THE BUNDLE, WITH THEIR LICENCE TEXT

PART 2. IN THE BUNDLE, LICENCE FILE NOT AVAILABLE WHEN THIS FILE WAS WRITTEN

These were identified in the shipped files the same way as Part 1. Their own
licence files (with the copyright lines an MIT, ISC or BSD notice has to carry)
could not be read at the time, so they are not reproduced here and still have
to be added. The licence named is what upstream's package-lock.json records
for the package; for the Rust crates the upstream repository records none.

  JavaScript and CSS
  - Base UI: @base-ui/react 1.8.0 with @base-ui/utils 0.4.0. Recorded licence: MIT.
  - dom-to-svg 0.12.x (upstream's lockfile gives version 0.12.3 and a 0.12.2
    tarball). Recorded licence: MIT.
  - postcss-value-parser 4.2.0. Recorded licence: MIT.
  - gradient-parser 1.2.0. No licence recorded in upstream's lockfile.
  - Tailwind CSS 4.3.3: its base styles and generated utilities make up
    editor/assets/index-*.css. Recorded licence: MIT.

  Rust, in the two WebAssembly modules
  - wasm-bindgen 0.2.117 (both modules).
  - lyon_tessellation 1.0.23 and lyon_path 1.0.19 (canvas module).
  - rstar 0.12.2 (canvas module).
  - etagere 0.2.15 (canvas module).
  - The Rust standard library (core, alloc, std; rustc 1.99.1) with
    dlmalloc 0.2.14 (both modules).

PART 3. DECLARED UPSTREAM, NOT FOUND IN THE BUNDLE

Listed so that nobody has to repeat the search; no notice is given for them.

  - source-map-js 1.2.2 (a PostCSS dependency): PostCSS refers to it through an
    empty stand-in in the bundle.
  - reselect 5.3.0 and @babel/runtime 7.29.14 (dependencies of Base UI): no
    identifying string or code was found.
  - Crates in upstream's Cargo.lock for the two modules that leave no
    identifying string in them: adler2, arrayvec, byteorder, cfg-if, euclid,
    float_next_after, hash32, heapless, js-sys, libm, lyon_geom, num-traits,
    once_cell, stable_deref_trait, svg_fmt, web-sys. Some of them are probably
    compiled in (lyon_geom and euclid are what the tessellator computes with);
    that could not be shown from the binary. The rest of that lockfile
    (proc-macro2, quote, syn, unicode-ident, rustversion, bumpalo, autocfg,
    wasm-bindgen-macro, wasm-bindgen-macro-support, wasm-bindgen-shared) are
    build-time tools.
